threads.body: The fragment filename `changelog.d/+.breaking.md` looks non-standard and may not be picked up by the changelog tooling (many setups require a numeric/unique prefix, e.g., `1234.breaking.md`). Rename this fragment to match the repository’s existing changelog fragment naming convention so automated release notes generation remains reliable.

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+Rename the `gen_ai.provider.name` value `mistral_ai` to `mistral` to match Mistral's brand name.

threads.body: This change renames both the registry `id` and the user-facing `value`. If `id` is consumed by code generation or other tooling, changing it is a larger (and potentially unnecessary) breaking change than renaming the `value`. Consider keeping `id: mistral_ai` and only changing `value` to `mistral`, or keeping both entries (e.g., `mistral` plus a deprecated `mistral_ai` alias) to preserve compatibility while still standardizing the emitted value.
